meta.source: Client assets supplied 2026-09-25..29: five-colour palette image, Canva brand profile (logo banner, product and service copy), Childos Arabic DEMO (not used). Derived tokens chosen for contrast.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page ground. Client palette colour #1 (cream). In Night it becomes a deep navy so the brand blue can stay the ground of hero bands.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on the cream ground: product cards, forms, the chat panel.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed wells inside a surface: fact tiles, ghost-button hover, code of an order reference.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on cream, surface, surface-sunk, pink and sky. 12.1:1 on cream (Cream); 14.7:1 on cream (Night).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta lines, help text, VAT note) on cream and surface. 6.8:1 (Cream), 9.8:1 (Night).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and resting card outlines. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and outline chips: 3.1:1 on cream (Cream), 4.2:1 (Night).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour (client #4). Header band, primary buttons, links, headings of service cards, selected states. 7.1:1 on cream in both themes.

tokens.name: blue-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a blue fill. 8.6:1 (Cream), 7.9:1 (Night).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Accent (client #2). Add-to-cart and booking CTAs with white text, the question-card disc, seasonal chips, badges, progress. Never small text: 3.9:1 on cream.

tokens.name: red-strong
tokens.usage: Hover fill of red CTAs.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text on a red fill. 4.6:1 — keep it 15px semibold or larger.

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: When red must be small text (errors, 'back on' notes): 5.5:1 on cream (Cream), 6.5:1 (Night).

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Soft surface (client #3): product art grounds, chips, quote bands. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Soft surface (client #5): assistant bubbles, question-card fronts, info chips, outline-button hover. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: on-soft
tokens.usage: Text on pink and sky. 9.4:1 (Cream), 9.9:1+ (Night).

tokens.name: brush
tokens.usage: The pink of the logo banner's brush strokes. Decoration only (brush strokes, blobs, nav underline on blue) — never text, never a control fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 3px offset. ≥7:1 on cream in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed states (order placed, paid) as text or icon, always with a word. 5.3:1 / 9.0:1.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention states (low stock, awaiting outcome), always with a word. 4.9:1 / 9.5:1.

families.display: "Baloo Bhaijaan 2", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: One per page: the home hero line.

styles.name: display-3
styles.usage: Card titles: product names, service names.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: نحن في دردشات نؤمن بأن التواصل هو جوهر العلاقات الإنسانية.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 45 بطاقة مقسّمة إلى 3 مراحل للتعارف والفهم والاكتشاف.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices and totals. Tabular figures, Latin digits, isolated LTR. Never the display face.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, fact-tile padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, minimum page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section inner padding, header padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Banner padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, fact tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Question cards and choice cards (the physical cards are softly rounded squares).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Product cards, banners, the header band, the chat panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards and hovered buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered product cards, the open chat panel, a picked Journey choice.

duration.note: Motion timings. Every animation also honours prefers-reduced-motion (cut to the end state).

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Press feedback, focus.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Hover lifts, message entry, underline sweeps.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Card deal-in, box lid tilt, progress fill.

tokens.name: dur-flip
tokens.usage: Question-card flip — the signature moment.

tokens.name: dur-draw
tokens.usage: Brush strokes drawing on in hero bands.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for entering and hover.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Playful overshoot: card flips, lids, cart bump. Only on objects that are 'things' (cards, boxes).

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Brush drawing, ambient float.
